correctness.summary: The defining integral series were reverted through third order; division gives a negative x^p coefficient for 1<p<p0 and a negative x^(2p0) coefficient at p0=(1+sqrt(7))/3, which contradicts strict increase from the finite right-hand limit.

limitations: No global classification is proved for p>(1+sqrt(7))/3.
The exact local obstruction threshold is not claimed to be the exact global monotonicity threshold.
Terminology-equivalent or weakly indexed prior coverage may have escaped the search.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2018 source explicitly states the conjecture. Searches by the exact ratio, conjecture/source identifiers, the decisive polynomial and algebraic threshold, and synonymous generalized-function terminology did not locate the counterexample interval. Broad later one-parameter inequality literature remains a residual prior-coverage risk.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The result disproves a published all-p conjecture on an exact nontrivial interval and gives a sharp local necessary parameter condition for any remaining monotonicity statement.
